_about: Read by zanatomy_export.py (which refuses blocked parts) and test-anatomy.js (which checks every recipe and every built manifest). Patterns are matched, case-insensitively, against an object's name, its parent group and every collection path it is in. The file records no per-object provenance, so these are deliberately broad: a false block costs one line in a recipe's allow_nc list; a false pass puts non-commercial material on a public site.
